newsitem.title: USA: Boston Technology, BellSouth in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Boston Technology, BellSouth in alliance.

text.p: Boston Technology Inc and BellSouth Telecommunications, a unit of BellSouth Corp, said Monday they signed a strategic alliance agreement.
The terms of the pact were not disclosed.

Under the agreement, Boston Technology will provide its Access NP Network Services Platforms, customer and marketing support, and software applications, including fax services, outdial message delivery, reminder services, unified mailboxes and Internet messaging.
BellSouth will provide messaging services to some customers through Boston Technology's subsidiary, Enhanced Communications Corp, the companies said.
"We are excited about this agreement with BellSouth and what it means to their customers," said Francis Girard, president and chief executive of Boston Technology.

"Our state-of-the-art capabilities will assist BellSouth in meeting the messaging needs of the ever-increasing number of people who rely on using multiple means of communications, such as fax, voice, as well as e- mail in their daily lives."
BellSouth said it created this program to bring its suppliers into a more strategic position with the company and to elaborate in the development of future features.
